name: Grilled Sausage Tacos with Spicy Charred Pepper & Pineapple Salsa
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut the bell peppers into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds. Place in a large bowl.

Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Add to the bowl. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard ends of the green onions; add to the bowl. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat.
Working in batches if necessary, place veggies on the grill. Cook until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side. Return grilled veggies to the bowl and set aside.
Place sausages on the grill and reduce heat to medium. Cook, turning occasionally, until sausages are cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, small dice grilled bell peppers, jalapeños, and half of the green onions (set aside the other half for garnish). Return chopped veggies to the bowl.
Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and small dice. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice one lime into the bowl and stir to combine the salsa. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside.
Meanwhile, slice sausages into ½-inch thick rounds, at an angle.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates.
To serve, fill lettuce with sausage, salsa, and whole grilled green onion. Garnish with lime wedges and enjoy!
author: Mealime
